about: Plain-word tasks a resident does on the live site. Each has a start surface, a success condition in reader terms and a tap budget (most taps allowed from the start). FE-18 runs them. No task names a particular place: the runner supplies a ZIP code for the place being checked.

tasks.title: Find when my council meets and how to comment
tasks.success: The page shows the date and time of the next council meeting, where it is held, and how to attend or comment, each with its source.

tasks.title: See how my mayor voted
tasks.success: The page shows the mayor's name and at least one recent vote with the outcome of the vote, each with its source.

tasks.title: Find the school district office and get directions
tasks.success: The page shows the school district office address, a map pin for it and a way to get directions.

tasks.title: Ask where the school district office is
tasks.success: The answer gives an address, a map pin, directions and hours, with the source for each.
tasks.question: Where is my school district office?

tasks.title: Ask when my city council meets next and what is on the agenda
tasks.success: The answer gives the next meeting date and its agenda items, with the source.
tasks.question: When does my city council meet next, and what's on the agenda?

tasks.title: Ask what my mayor voted on at the last council meeting
tasks.success: The answer lists the votes the mayor cast at the last meeting and how each turned out, with the source.
tasks.question: What did my mayor vote on at the last council meeting, and how did it turn out?

tasks.title: Ask who is running for my state house seat and where they stand on housing
tasks.success: The answer lists the candidates for the seat, matching the ballot page, and says what each says about housing or says plainly that it is still being gathered.
tasks.question: Who is running for my state house seat, and what do they say about housing?

tasks.title: Ask who gives money to my member of Congress
tasks.success: The answer names the biggest funders with amounts, or says plainly that the figures are still being gathered, with the source.
tasks.question: Who gives money to my member of Congress?

tasks.title: Ask what a ballot measure does and what a no vote means
tasks.success: The answer says in plain English what the measure does and what a yes vote and a no vote each mean, with the source.
tasks.question: What does the measure on my ballot actually do, and what does a NO vote mean?

tasks.title: See an official's portrait and how to contact them
tasks.success: An official's page shows their portrait and at least one way to reach them (phone, email, form or page), each with its source.

tasks.title: See how an official voted and who funds them
tasks.success: An official's page shows recent votes with outcomes and their funding, or says plainly that a part is still being gathered.

tasks.title: Find a government office on the map and get directions
tasks.success: Tapping an office pin shows its address and a directions link.

tasks.title: See an upcoming meeting's agenda and how to attend or comment
tasks.success: An upcoming meeting shows its agenda and how to attend or comment.

tasks.title: See what a past meeting decided
tasks.success: A concluded meeting shows its results.

tasks.title: See my ballot in plain English with deadlines and polling place
tasks.success: The ballot lists the contests in plain English, with the registration and voting deadlines and the polling place.
